# Calidigi — California Digital Growth & AI Company

> Calidigi is a California-based digital growth company helping businesses attract customers, generate leads, and grow through web development, digital marketing, local SEO, branding, and AI-powered solutions.

## About

Calidigi is a full-service digital agency headquartered in San Francisco, California. We work with businesses across 30+ industries to build stronger digital presences, automate operations with AI, and create measurable growth opportunities. We have delivered 500+ projects with a 98% client retention rate and generated $50M+ in client revenue.

## Services

- **Web Design & Development** — High-converting websites, landing pages, e-commerce, CMS development, and performance optimization
- **Digital Marketing** — SEO, content marketing, social media marketing, paid campaigns, lead generation, and analytics
- **Local SEO** — Google Business Profile optimization, local keyword strategy, citation building, and reputation management
- **Branding & Creative** — Brand strategy, logo design, visual identity systems, and marketing materials
- **AI Solutions** — AI integration, custom AI model development, LLM fine-tuning, business automation, and predictive analytics
- **Custom Software** — SaaS development, API design, enterprise web applications, cloud-native architecture

## Industries Served

Healthcare, Real Estate, E-Commerce, SaaS & Tech, Legal, Restaurant & Hospitality, Solar Energy, Education, Home Services, Logistics, Manufacturing, Finance, and 20+ more industries across California.
